svg.text: Turns share the session pool, background calls the tool pool
Each pool has its own scheduler and limits; model calls are limited per connection, apart from both
A waiting turn holds no slot; a long tool call need not hold one either
32 slots by default, a cap per user; one per running turn
Tool execution takes none of these
32 slots, 4 per user, up to an hour each
The turn has the call's "started" and goes on;
the result comes back as a report
Holds no slot and no model concurrency
A report comes from a subagent
Ready again once the approval, answer or report arrives: back to the session queue
